dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.heroBody: Track the pulse of users, roles, and permissions. The summary combines new accounts for the period, account status, active roles, registered permissions, and access coverage.
dashboard.periodHint: The period filters new user accounts. The remaining indicators reflect the current system state.
dashboard.customRangeErrorRequired: Complete both dates to use a custom range.
dashboard.customRangeErrorOrder: The start date cannot be later than the end date.
dashboard.comparisonUnavailableHint: This filter has no equivalent previous period.
dashboard.summaryLoadError: The administration summary could not be loaded. {reason}
dashboard.kpiUsersDescription: Accounts created within the selected period.
dashboard.kpiRolesDescription: Current roles available to group permissions.
dashboard.kpiPermissionsDescription: Module and action combinations assigned to roles.
dashboard.kpiAccessCaption: {users} of {active} active users with a role
dashboard.kpiAccessDescription: Active users with at least one current role.
dashboard.focusBody: Three areas sustain portal security: accounts, roles, and effective permissions.
dashboard.focusUsers: Users: sign-ups, pending activations, inactive accounts, and last access.
dashboard.focusRoles: Roles: validity, number of assignments, and unused roles.
dashboard.focusPermissions: Permissions: covered modules, exposed actions, and assignments per role.
dashboard.guideBody: Each color communicates a different administration area in the dashboard.
dashboard.guideUsersDescription: Primary color for sign-ups, period growth, and account status.
dashboard.guideRolesDescription: Secondary color for role structure and assignments.
dashboard.guidePermissionsDescription: Gold accent for effective permissions and covered modules.
dashboard.guideAccessDescription: Informational teal for active users versus assigned access.
dashboard.guideRiskDescription: Mustard and terracotta only for pending accounts, lockouts, or real exceptions.
dashboard.statusBody: These chips summarize the usual status of an account or role in Administration.
dashboard.alertSuccess: OK: an active user has at least one current role with permissions.
dashboard.alertInfo: Attention: an active account without a role cannot access any section.
dashboard.alertWarning: Review: pending or locked accounts require administrative action.

session.inactivityWarning: Due to inactivity, you will be signed out in {seconds} seconds.
session.willSignOutAutomatically: You will be signed out automatically for security.
